Subject: Access trace handover & export options for audit window

Hi Sean,

Per our upcoming compliance review (May->June window), we need to confirm Redwood's ability to hand over access traces and audit logs for our tenant. Specifically:

- What export formats do you support (NDJSON, CSV, parquet)?
- Can exports be scoped to specific time windows (start/end timestamps) and tenant identifiers?
- Are exports delivered via signed URL, SFTP, or direct push to our AWS bucket?
- If data resides in multiple regions, can we request a single consolidated export?
- What guarantees do you provide about deletion after handover (proof of deletion or tombstone/purge report)?

We'd appreciate an initial playbook and an estimate for a 90-day window extract. Procurement is looped in for timing and cost.

Thanks,

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then a suggested playbook below.

- Formats: NDJSON (preferred), gzipped parquet (recommended for large windows), CSV for small slices.
- Scoping: yes — exports can be filtered by tenant_id, date range, and log type (audit/access/error).
- Delivery: support for pre-signed S3 URLs (preferred), SFTP, and direct push to customer-managed buckets.
- Consolidation: we can materialize a single export even if records live in different regions; export job will stitch and present as one file set.
- Deletion proof: we provide an erase manifest and a signed checksum/tombstone report after delivery; chain-of-custody metadata is included.

Suggested playbook (high-level):
1) Discovery call (1–2 business days): confirm tenant ids, target time window, and preferred format/delivery.
2) Export job scheduling: we schedule an extraction slot (typical turnaround 3–5 business days for ~90 days of logs).
3) Delivery & verification: pre-signed S3 transfer + checksum + manifest. Customer verifies and confirms receipt.
4) Erase & attestation: we run deletion of staging/export artifacts and provide a signed deletion report (MD5 checksums, timestamps, operator id).

I've attached our export-format summary and a checklist we use for handback. If you want, Vanessa (CC'd) can run through the SLA/ops items and Kar... can chime on any residency constraints.

Thanks,

Hi Maya — following up with clarifications and a proposed MAP (mutual action plan) so we can hit procurement timelines.

Residency: we can perform regional staging. For EU tenant slices we will run the export job on EU-hosted nodes and stage outputs in an EU S3 bucket we create for the transfer. If you prefer we can also push directly to your EU bucket (you provide write IAM role).

Purge proof / attestation: we produce a signed deletion manifest that includes: export_job_id, list of files, MD5 checksums, operator id, deletion timestamps, and our signing certificate fingerprint. The signing uses our HSM-backed KMS (FIPS 140-2 module), and we can provide the cert chain for your auditors.

PII redaction: this is an optional post-processing step. We support regex-based PII masking (emails, phone numbers, common SSN formats) and can run it as a separate export job; note that redaction increases job time and requires explicit acceptance that some forensic fidelity will be lost.

Costs / turnaround: for a 90-day, multi-region export with optional PII-scan and EU staging: estimate 4–7 business days turnaround and a one-time professional service fee of $4,500 plus egress costs. If you provide a hosted bucket and accept pre-signed S3 delivery we can reduce the fee by ~15%.

Proposed MAP:
- By EOD Fri (2028-06-29): confirm tenant_id(s), preferred delivery (pre-signed S3 vs push), and whether PII redaction is required.
- Mon 2028-07-02: schedule extraction window and confirm cost acceptance via procurement.
- Wed 2028-07-04 to Fri 2028-07-06: export & delivery window (depends on final scope).
- Mon 2028-07-08: we provide deletion attestation.

I've uploaded the export formats and the handback checklist to the HubSpot record and linked the MAP. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/LogiBank-record-9001
